next_action: Separate startup asset import/compile cost, completed reload overhead and communication/target-switch stalls. Preserve caches and the same live process; compare controlled conditions before claiming an optimization.
limitations: Statistics cover completed profiler markers only and provide no duration estimate for a hang.
